caption: “Scanning electron microscopy analysis of colony variants of M. vaccae. (A) smooth; (B) rough,” from Elisabeth Rodriguez-Guell, et al. (2006).
alt: Two electron-microscope images, side by side, of bacteria magnified thousands of times: on the left, a few rod-shaped cells among frost-like crystals; on the right, a dense mat of rods stacked like logs.
bibliography: Rodríguez-Güell, Elisabeth, et al. "Scanning Electron Microscopy Analysis of Colony Variants of M. vaccae." "A New Extracellular Putative Long-Chain Saturated Polyester Produced by Smooth Variants of Mycobacterium vaccae Interferes with Th1-Cytokine Production," Antonie van Leeuwenhoek, vol. 90, no. 1, 2006, pp. 93–108.
